review_summary: Only source/utils/track.cpp is modified; headers have no diff.
New helpers are in the existing anonymous namespace and do not add exported API.
TrackBoxMatchLoss matches the old computeMatchLoss formula exactly, and computeMatchLoss now delegates to it.

SelectTrackedBodyDetection preserves detection iteration order, usedDetections filtering, strict tie behavior, bestTrackLoss update semantics, dummyLoss rejection gate, and PredictMotion plus predBox side effect.
SelectFaceAnchoredBodyDetection preserves face-to-body filter, anchor loss, usedDetections, iteration order, and bestAcquireLoss semantics.
Downstream miss, retire, publish, body evidence flow, profile logic, and hand path are unchanged.
residual_risks: Runtime replay and unit tests were not executed.
